Why it works

Mom's satin skirt is the anchor: the one piece with real shine, so it catches the low sun and the eye lands on her first. Green runs through the whole family in different shades and fabrics (Dad's knit, the plaids, a soft mint floral), so it reads like a theme, never a uniform. Ivory and stone lighten it up, and navy on Mom and her son adds depth against the black iron. The two plaids share the same greens in different garments, and the floral stays small and soft. Cable knits and suede add cozy texture.
